g.title: VCN
g.text: BC250 VCN — evidence and remaining boundaries
Ring worker, late completion and contribution audit findings • 2026-10-02

g.title: legend
g.text: GREEN: stated finding proven / solved within its scope
ORANGE: pertinent evidence; stage or connection unresolved
RED: no established result for the stated outcome
Static and offline proofs do not establish hardware execution.
Arrows show dependencies, not observed execution order.

g.title: discovery
g.text: PROVEN STATIC DISCOVERY
P2/P3: VCN 2.0.3; no discovery harvest entries.
Discovery does not establish powered or usable silicon.

g.title: admission
g.text: DRIVER ADMITS VCN 2.0.3 — ORANGE
Actual custom kernel admission / patches unverified.
Examined upstream discovery skips 2.0.3.
Software harvest mask can skip firmware registration.

g.title: platform
g.text: ACTUAL PLATFORM POWER / CLOCK ENABLE — ORANGE
Examined Cyan table lacks dpm_set_vcn_enable.
Zero return / cached state can hide no operation.
Driver request → actual BC250 enable dispatch unresolved.

g.title: selection
g.text: SELECT AND REGISTER FIRMWARE — ORANGE
Reference fallback: amdgpu/vcn_2_0_3.bin.
Navi10 candidate audited; active candidate after Sept 27.
Navi10 / Van Gogh executable compatibility unproven.
Actual submitted file, hash and harvest variable needed.

g.title: domain
g.text: PMFW VIDEO DOMAIN / LOCAL CONTROLS — ORANGE
Row 6 parents VCLK / DCLK; physical bit meanings open.
Parent: OR 1 at 0116d17c; wait bit 8 at 0116d190;
write 10000 at 0116d184; wait bit 16 clear.
Cache f714=1 can bypass; matching idle samples suffice.
Child completion differs from parent acknowledgment.
Actual clocks, physical power and PSP/SMU ordering open.
Reference PGFSM_STATUS MMIO offset: 1f804.

g.title: load
g.text: PROVEN STATIC ORDINARY LOADER ROUTE
LOAD_IP_FW command 6 / type 13
t02 202616 → 2013ca → F2 service 1 / message 1007
→ t28 e0d9dc → allocation e0a900 → image e16d88
→ completion e0fb18 / type-13 case e0fc0c.
Type 13 allocation case reserves 100000 bytes.
AUTOLOAD 21 is separate; command 8 is SAVE_RESTORE.
Existence of code does not prove live invocation success.

g.title: boundary
g.text: SOURCE-AUDITED LOADER / DRIVER DIFFERENCE
All-ones POWER_STATUS returns before PGFSM / localCGC.
Later loader omits CGC_CTRL clear7ffff800, including REGS_MODE,
and SUVD programming. Ordinary CGC_GATE clear matches.
Omission is not the executed cause of the earlier return.
Compare only after independently valid MMIO access.

g.title: domain->boundary
g.text: access observation

g.title: windows
g.text: PROGRAM FIRMWARE / STACK / CONTEXT WINDOWS — ORANGE
Reference mappings and register offsets recovered.
PSP mode cache0 requires accepted returned TMR address.
Stack, context and shared data use separate GPU allocations.
Actual BC250 mappings / successful programming unobserved.

g.title: clocks
g.text: PROVEN STATIC CLOCK IDENTITIES / REACHABILITY
Metrics ABI: child 23 VCLK; child 22 DCLK; parent 6.
Q3/Q4 1d selectors 16 / 15; sibling selector 11.
Feature bit 13 installs policy worker in callback slot 24.
Worker state equality can suppress application.

g.title: policy
g.text: SSIP POLICY RECOVERY — STRONG STATIC INFERENCE
SSIP aligns all 20 worker slots and a second initializer.
CONST.S supports configuration; shared opcode with SSIU.
BIOS table upload → validate/copy 49c bytes → state policy.
Indices14/15 → DCLK/VCLK; 19 → child12, parent1.
Equal worker states skip application; setter does not advance gate.
Runtime configuration and applied values remain unverified.

g.title: sections
g.text: SECTION CONSUMERS / STORED ACCESS POLICY — ORANGE
B=e5cbdc / e1177c: ordinary pairs → SVC7c;203/217 direct.
Cached210 → SVC7d mapping → mapped store.
P3 t24/t45:1405/144 pairs; no explicit frame-C / VCN-valued rows.
Direct preloads1f8a4=0b and1f820=185103.
Five late1f8c4..1f8d4 entries are capture/replay, not defaults.
Runtime producer, enable and live grants remain open.

g.title: auth
g.text: KEY ID → CONDITIONAL USAGE → SIGNATURE — ORANGE
Type 13 maps to usage 6. Lookup reads e25834.
Missing ID → ffff0008 before SVC87 / verification.
Matched ID + enforced usage mismatch → 80000205.
SVC87 policy byte 6007 comes from startup register sample.
Live table, policy and exact rejecting branch unobserved.
A response code alone does not locate the failure.

g.title: worker
g.text: RECOVERED t02 RING WORKER AND COMMAND ROUTES
Boot-created worker2022ac → consumer203558 → dispatcher20243c.
64-byte frames; advances16 dwords and wraps.
Command6 LOAD_IP_FW; command8 SAVE/RESTORE.
AUTOLOAD21 → message1059 → examined default-error path.
Independent review pending; runtime execution unobserved.

g.title: worker->load
g.text: command6 / type13

g.title: context
g.text: RECOVERED LATE-WRITE CONTEXT PRODUCER
Worker literal0000ffff → argument5 → message+44
→ ordinary loader → completion argument2.
Type13 + full context0000ffff selects0900c004 <- 1.
Not a hardware-ready flag; ffffffff does not match.
Both context outcomes reach late1f8a4 <- 1 helper.

g.title: worker->context
g.text: context producer

g.title: completion
g.text: RECOVERED LATE COMPLETION AND MMSCH BOOKKEEPING
Final image-processing error skips ordinary completion.
Late helper discards SVC write result; acceptance not proven.
After writes: mapped-buffer helper → read MMSCH state[19].
Nonzero19 suppresses helper error; VCN marks slot13.
RLC slots21/22 differ; no proven RLC-ready dependency.

g.title: context->completion
g.text: argument-specific path

g.title: resets
g.text: RELEASE VCPU / MEMORY RESETS — ORANGE
Reference startup order / reset controls recovered.
PSP writes 1 to 0900c004 and late 1f8a4 are known.
Their physical meaning / routing remains unresolved.
They are not demonstrated substitutes for driver reset release.
RESTORE needs prior loaded metadata; not cold-start proof.

g.title: completion->resets
g.text: physical effect unresolved

g.title: late_comparison
g.text: NAVI12 LATE HANDSHAKE — COMPARISON ONLY
MMSCH completion publishes high/low address words via1e130.
Commands1/2 at1e058 each require1e05c == 80000001.
VCN state[19] path can republish the shared record.
Checked software coupling in comparison image.
Not an established BC250 startup sequence.

g.title: tests
g.text: REPEATABLE OFFLINE CONTRIBUTION REVIEW
16 selected auditor commands pass; outputs and hashes saved.
ISA layouts, parent fixtures, clock identities, driver/PSP contracts,
stored policy coverage, DMA, snapshot and Navi10 crypto controls.
Ghidra1290→1297 functions;97→7 halt_baddata;158 added edges.
Source checks and fixtures are not hardware observations.

g.title: accepted
g.text: ACCEPTED IMAGE / USABLE TMR ADDRESS — ORANGE
Allocation, completion and saved metadata recovered.
Driver C return zero can coexist with PSP error.
Raw response + returned destination must be checked.
No demonstrated accepted BC250 cold-start image.

g.title: accepted->completion
g.text: successful processing prerequisite

g.title: accepted->windows
g.text: accepted image + usable address

g.title: ready
g.text: ACTUAL BC250 VCPU EXECUTION — RED
No established firmware-ready observation.
Known reference criterion: UVD_STATUS & 2.
Control readback / invalid all-ones reads are insufficient.

g.title: service
g.text: PROVEN STATIC PSP SERVICE CHAIN
Object loader → entry installation → SVC74 binding
→ F2 invocation → t28 entry / dispatcher.
Message 1000 initializer gates ordinary messages.
Runtime loading / binding success remains unobserved.

g.title: fixtures
g.text: PROVEN FIXTURE / CRYPTO CONTROL RESULTS
Extracted P3 BL/TOS miss candidate IDs: modeledffff0008.
Navi10 signature verifies with matching reference key.
Wrong-usage fixture rejects; corrupted message fails signature.
Matching-key control differs from stock-table lookup.
Live KDB identity and BC250 acceptance remain unverified.

g.title: producer
g.text: RUNTIME KDB PRODUCER — ORANGE
Known: boot config → staging base → base+784000
→ t28 initializer copy → e25834 consumer.
Earlier staging producer / live bytes unresolved.
SPI double-fetch / FPGA plan belongs here only if its
fetch is connected to this consumed object; no success proof.

g.title: candidate
g.text: PROVEN VAN GOGH REFERENCE — OFFLINE ONLY
vangogh-candidate.json: IP 3.0; payload 572112 bytes;
bounds and CRC valid; ID 70ec3e2d8a694792ac7969ff8ac9caca.
Separate OpenSSL test verifies signature with Steam Deck key.
Not BC250 acceptance / compatibility; historical candidate.

g.title: comparison
g.text: COMPARISON / NEGATIVE RESULTS — ORANGE
Row-7 GFX tuples and cleanup: no proven row-6 propagation.
PSP targets do not match row-6 controls under slot model.
Navi12 sequences remain comparative, not BC250 recipes.
PS5 SEC_LDR 259/260 extracted; VCN consumer / routing open.

g.title: ring
g.text: ACTUAL VCN-EXECUTED RING RESULT — RED
No demonstrated result. Known test: seed scratch9
CAFEDEAD; VCN packet must produce DEADBEEF.
begin_use can discard startup error; capture first failure.

g.title: media
g.text: WORKING HARDWARE DECODE / ENCODE — RED
No established functional result in saved evidence.
Decode known sample with software fallback disabled;
validate output; establish encode separately.

g.title: next
g.text: NEXT MATCHED OBSERVATIONS
1. Command/type/context → final image status → completion → state19/results.
2. Active BIOS policy + worker gates → parent/child observations → accessibility.
3. Runtime section contents / kind and accepted-store evidence.
4. Valid MMIO → complete localCGC → VCPU → ring → media.
Credit: daveconde, rw-r-r-0644 and community contributors.
No hardware operation was performed by the contribution audits.

g.title: transport
g.text: OBSERVATION / TRANSPORT TOOLING — ORANGE
SMU unlock + mapped-read path recovered.
DMA ordering / completion and offline replay audited.
PSP backing-address translation / accessibility unproven.
Mock completion / fixture success is not hardware proof.
